objective: Implement a governed vendor-neutral time-series optimized query-layer baseline with deterministic partitioning, stable ordering, provenance-preserving records, bounded half-open queries and measurable index-pruning behavior without selecting a production database.
scope: Define provider-neutral immutable time-series record and query contracts
Index canonical historical records by canonical instrument and fixed time partition
Use binary-search slicing inside sorted time partitions
Support half-open time windows with canonical-id, provider and event-kind filters
Return deterministic stable ordering, result limits and truncation metadata
Preserve raw archive linkage through exact source payload digest/object reference fields
Reject duplicate record identities and unsafe archive references
Bound index size, query result size and partitions per query through policy
Generate deterministic P06-C evidence proving partition pruning and stable query identity
Run a measured synthetic query benchmark with a fail-closed minimum throughput threshold
Reconcile P06-C active task/lock state across GitHub and Linear
out_of_scope: Selecting PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, ClickHouse or any production database/query vendor
Provisioning production storage, cloud services, credentials or network connections
Provider acquisition, trading, order execution, KYC, funding or production activation
dependencies: P02-C Data Flow & Storage Architecture frozen and vendor-neutral
Fresh Live Guard: no active task, active lock or open PR at execution start
tests: Strict Pyright passes for P06 product source
Half-open time-window semantics exclude end boundary
Canonical-id/provider/kind filters return only matching records
Stable query order is deterministic for equal timestamps
Binary-search time slicing and partition pruning reduce candidates for bounded queries
Query limits report truncation without changing matched_count
Unsafe raw archive references fail closed
Index fingerprint changes when canonical payload content changes
No production database/vendor import exists in historical-data core
P06-C deterministic evidence is byte-identical across two runs
Measured synthetic query benchmark exceeds the governed minimum throughput
security_tests: No credential or network access is required
Source raw evidence references cannot traverse outside the archive namespace
rollback: Revert the P06-C reference query module, policy, tests, performance/evidence wiring and P06-C active-state reconciliation. P06-A/P06-B remain canonical; no production database/storage selection, credential, network connection or trading state is changed.
definition_of_ready: No active governed task or lock at Fresh Live Guard
No open pull request conflicting with shared state
definition_of_done: Vendor-neutral time-series optimized query baseline implemented
Partition pruning and stable half-open queries verified
Deterministic P06-C evidence and measured benchmark pass
Strict Pyright and governance CI pass
Post-merge Governance and Branch Hygiene pass
